column2: Great King Enma-sama!?
I asked him to move Hell Villa near the Photon Power Lab! And then he goes, "I'm coming too!"...
When I heard Chapeau-jii's report, I simply couldn't sit still!
Thank you, Great King Enma-sama!
Let me join your party too, {p}!
Yes! Gladly!
GWAHAHAHAHA!
Could you take me with you too? I want to ask the prophet... when I'll have to go back to the Kigoku World.
All right! Let's go together, Jiro-kun!
Thanks.
Ready? Then let's go...!
Herai Village is a small village northeast of here, north of Science City. Dr. Kuruma is searching for the Precog Clan too. Be very careful!
A Mechanical Beast under maintenance?
GUGAAAH!!
Whoa! It started moving!!
GAAAAH!!
I don't care what comes at me, I'll smash it!!
What a lonely village...
Sure looks like a place a prophet would live.\n\nLet's start by asking the villagers.
No good... Everyone seems to be avoiding us.
It's less like avoiding us...\n\nand more like they're wary of us.
Whoa!
Who's there!?
...! You are...!?
You're looking for the Precog Clan...
You read our minds!?
I sense something in you... A power different from Shusha-kun's...
You sense something...? And who's Shusha-kun...?
Sorry to startle you. My name is Chigusa Mitsurugi.
Oh, h-h-hi. I'm {p}.
I'm Jiro Shutendo.
I'm searching for gifted precognitives to prepare for a coming calamity.
A coming calamity?
I can't tell you the details. But danger is drawing near. That's why I came to Herai Village... but it was no use. The Precog Clan isn't here!
So you read our minds to see if we knew anything?
I apologize. I'm sorry.
No... um...
You're someone who can be trusted. That much even I can tell.
Y-yeah! Same here!
Tee-hee... You two seem like good people! As an apology, I'll tell you.\n\nMaria, the Precog Clan's greatest prophet, isn't here. It seems she fled the village.
Where did this Maria go?
I don't know. It seems the villagers are searching for her too... ...!?
I'll be taking my leave now.\n\nIf the chance comes, let's meet again!
She vanished...
What an incredible psychic...
Wh-whoa, now what!?
Who's there!?
What a lonely place this is...!
H-hey!
Listen! My name is Rei Uryu!
I've bought this village! Kindly clear out at once!
Eeeek!
H-help us!
Hmph! I've no use for the powerless!
Oh my... Well, well... How do you do, my name is...
Rei Uryu, right?
Oh? How do you know my name...? Could it be you're psychics!?
You just told us yourself a second ago...
...! So Chigusa Mitsurugi came here.
Looks like this guy's a psychic too...?
Ha! Now this is interesting!
I sense some strange power in you! Almost like his...
No, it seems different from Shingo Shusha's too...
Did you hear that? The name Shusha came up again...?
Yeah. Who is this Shusha anyway...?
In any case!
Maria is not here!\n\nYou two intrigue me greatly, but finding Maria is my top priority! No hard feelings!
...Fine by us, but...
A final word of advice...\n\nFor your own good, stay away from Chigusa Mitsurugi...!
Chigusa Mitsurugi... Rei Uryu... They're both incredible psychics! And neither seems to have oni blood!
And... they both mentioned that Shusha guy...
It bugs me...\n\nAnd they both said Maria isn't in this village...
Look out, {p}!
Yahooo!
Smash it, smash it, smash it all to bits!
Wreck this whole village clean off the map!
The villagers are in danger!
Y-you folks... savin' our village...
We're much obliged! Thank ya! Thank ya! If there's anythin' we can do fer ya, don't be shy!
The villagers finally opened up to us. I hope we can learn something...
Maria and Tomisaburo, descendants of the Precog Clan, up and left the village one day, like they was runnin' away.
Maria was a mighty fine prophet, she was! Ain't never gonna be another one like her.
There's a bad sort out to use Maria's power, I reckon. She ran off to get away from him, sure as anythin'.
Maria's got herself a sweetheart, y'know.\n\nShe didn't run off, she eloped with him, I reckon.
Why's there a village way out in the sticks like this? Well, I'll tell ya! It's so nobody'd see it!
Well, I'll be, what's goin' on?\n\nIt ain't snowmelt season, but the river's risin'?
The Flood Generator is nearly complete!
Dr. Shaft, we're ready for the maximum output test.
If we can make a flood that washes away the village, the experiment's a success!
This will make a perfect example of them!\n\nI do hope it makes that woman reconsider a little... Very well, do it!
Stop!

Who are you people!? Hm? Could it be...? It's you! You're the ones who got in Dr. Kuruma's way in Science City! Fools, to interfere with our sacred goal... Let me show you the results of my experiments... Come forth, my sons!!
Inside my body are many sons. My sons will eliminate anyone who gets in my way! Get them, my sons!!
At this rate, there's no end to them...!
Shaft...!
